privacy.learnhowscoutmasterhandles: Learn how Scoutmaster handles account information and scouting records.
privacy.p1: Welcome to Scoutmaster, a scouting tool for FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) robotics teams. This Privacy Policy explains what information we collect, how we use and share it, and the choices available to you when using Scoutmaster.
privacy.p1/2: Scoutmaster is independently developed and operated. We aim to collect only the information needed to provide accounts and synchronize scouting records between teammates.
privacy.p2: Scoutmaster is intended for individuals aged 13 and older. You must be at least 13 years old to create an account or use the service. Children under 13 are not permitted to use Scoutmaster or create an account.
privacy.p2/2: Scoutmaster does not currently use a separate age verification process. If we become aware that a user under 13 has created an account, we will take appropriate steps to address the situation, including restricting the account and deleting personal information where required by applicable law.
privacy.p2/3: If you believe someone under 13 is using Scoutmaster, please contact us at sdhs_stormbot16423@outlook.com.
privacy.p3: Scoutmaster collects information needed to provide the service, including:
privacy.p3/1: Used for account authentication and access to Scoutmaster.
privacy.p3/2: Robot performance observations, scouting notes, team strategies, and related records entered by users.
privacy.p3/3: Please avoid including unnecessary personal or sensitive information about yourself or others in scouting notes.
privacy.p4/2: Store and synchronize scouting records between members of the same team.
privacy.p4/3: Maintain the service and its account and database access controls.
privacy.p4/4: Send authentication related emails when needed to support account access.
privacy.p4/5: Scoutmaster is not intended to use your information for advertising or promotional emails.
privacy.p5: Scoutmaster is designed to let members of the same team access shared scouting records. Database access restrictions are intended to prevent members of one team from accessing another team's records.
privacy.p5/2: Other authorized members of your team may be able to view scouting information you enter into shared records. Please consider this before submitting information.
privacy.p5/3: Scoutmaster uses the following service providers:
privacy.p5/4: Provides account authentication and cloud database services.
privacy.p5/7: These providers may process information as needed to provide their services. Their handling of information is also subject to their applicable terms and privacy practices.
privacy.p5/8: We do not intend to sell users' personal information. Information may also be disclosed where required by law or in response to valid legal requests.
privacy.p6: Scoutmaster uses cloud services to store account and scouting information and synchronize records between teammates.
privacy.p6/2: Scoutmaster is available internationally. Depending on the services involved, information may be processed or stored in countries other than your own, where different privacy laws may apply. We do not specify a guaranteed storage country in this policy.
privacy.p7: Scoutmaster's intended practice is to retain scouting records for the relevant robotics season. At the end of a season, older records are removed manually rather than automatically. Until removed, these records may remain stored and available to authorized team members.
privacy.p7/2: Account information is retained while needed to provide the account and service, unless it is deleted.
privacy.p7/3: We have not verified the retention period for copies that may remain in service-provider backups. Deletion from the active service may therefore not mean immediate removal from every backup.
privacy.p8: Users can delete their accounts through the account deletion functionality provided by Scoutmaster.
privacy.p8/2: Deleting an account removes the account, but scouting records shared with teammates may remain available to the team. Account deletion does not remove every record associated with the user's previous activity.
privacy.p8/3: Copies retained in backups may not be removed immediately. Where applicable law gives you a right to request deletion of personal information, you may contact sdhs_stormbot16423@outlook.com for assistance.
privacy.p9: Scoutmaster uses authentication and database access restrictions to help protect accounts and limit access to stored information.
privacy.p9/2: No online service or method of electronic storage can be guaranteed to be completely secure. We cannot promise that information will never be accessed, disclosed, altered, or lost without authorization.
privacy.p10: This policy does not identify a separate analytics or advertising service currently used by Scoutmaster. Hosting, authentication, and application infrastructure may process technical information as part of providing their services.
privacy.p10/2: If Scoutmaster introduces additional cookies, analytics, advertising technologies, or other data collection practices, this policy will be updated as appropriate.
privacy.p11: You can choose what scouting information you enter into Scoutmaster and should avoid including unnecessary personal information in shared notes.
privacy.p11/2: Depending on the laws that apply to you, you may have rights to request access to, correction of, or deletion of your personal information, or to withdraw consent where consent is the basis for processing.
privacy.p11/3: To ask a privacy question or make a request, contact sdhs_stormbot16423@outlook.com.
privacy.p12: Scoutmaster is independently operated from Canada and is intended for international use. The privacy laws that apply may depend on where you live, the nature of the service, and how your information is handled.
privacy.p12/2: We will handle personal information in accordance with applicable legal requirements. This policy is not a guarantee that every legal requirement in every country has been independently assessed or satisfied.
privacy.p13: We may update this Privacy Policy as Scoutmaster changes or as legal requirements evolve. The updated version will be published with a revised effective date. Where required, we will provide notice or obtain consent for material changes.
privacy.p14: If you have questions about this Privacy Policy, the information Scoutmaster handles, or a privacy request, contact us at:

terms.description: The rules and conditions for using Scoutmaster.
terms.p1: Welcome to Scoutmaster, an independently operated scouting tool for FIRST Tech Challenge (FTC) robotics teams. These Terms of Service explain the rules for using Scoutmaster.
terms.p1/2: By creating an account or using Scoutmaster, you agree to these terms. If you do not agree, please do not use the service.
terms.p2: Scoutmaster is intended for individuals aged 13 and older. You must be at least 13 years old to create an account or use the service. Users under 13 are not permitted to use Scoutmaster.
terms.p2/2: By using Scoutmaster, you confirm that you meet this age requirement. Scoutmaster does not currently use a separate age verification process.
terms.p3: You are responsible for providing a valid email address and keeping your account credentials secure. Do not share your login credentials or allow others to use your account without authorization.
terms.p3/2: If you believe your account has been accessed without permission, contact sdhs_stormbot16423@outlook.com.
terms.p4: Scoutmaster is currently provided free of charge. We may introduce new features, change existing features, or consider different pricing in the future. Any changes will be handled in accordance with applicable law.
terms.p5: You agree to use Scoutmaster responsibly and only for lawful purposes. You must not:
terms.p5/1: Access another team's account, data, or systems without permission.
terms.p5/2: Hack, exploit vulnerabilities, or disrupt Scoutmaster or its infrastructure.
terms.p5/3: Harass, threaten, or abuse other users.
terms.p5/4: Scrape, collect, copy, or redistribute service data without appropriate authorization.
terms.p5/5: Use Scoutmaster for unlawful purposes or to infringe another person's rights.
terms.p6: Scoutmaster allows users to create and share robot performance observations, scouting notes, team strategies, and other scouting records.
terms.p6/2: Teams retain ownership of their shared scouting records. Scoutmaster uses submitted records to provide and synchronize the service.
terms.p6/3: Team members may use, export, and share their team's records. You are responsible for ensuring that any information you share is appropriate and that you have permission when required.
terms.p6/4: Do not submit confidential information, personal information about others, or material you are not authorized to share.
terms.p7: Scoutmaster and its original software, design, branding, and related materials are owned by their respective rights holders. These terms do not transfer ownership of Scoutmaster to users.
terms.p7/2: Scoutmaster is independently operated and is not officially affiliated with, endorsed by, or sponsored by FIRST or FIRST Tech Challenge.
terms.p8: We do not guarantee that scouting records, observations, strategies, or other information entered by users are accurate, complete, or up to date.
terms.p8/2: Users and teams are responsible for evaluating the information they rely on. Scoutmaster does not guarantee competition results, robot performance, or the success of any strategy.
terms.p9: Scoutmaster is provided on an as-is and as-available basis, to the extent permitted by applicable law.
terms.p9/2: We do not guarantee uninterrupted, error-free service or that scouting records will always be available or recoverable. Maintenance, technical issues, and third-party outages may affect availability.
terms.p9/3: We may change, suspend, or discontinue features or parts of Scoutmaster.
terms.p10: You may stop using Scoutmaster and delete your account through the account deletion functionality provided by the service.
terms.p10/2: We may restrict, suspend, or terminate access where reasonably necessary because of a violation of these terms, a security concern, unlawful activity, or the discontinuation of Scoutmaster.
terms.p10/3: Deleting an account does not necessarily delete scouting records already shared with teammates. Such records may remain available to the team, subject to our Privacy Policy and applicable law.
terms.p11: Scoutmaster uses third-party services, including Supabase for authentication and database services, Render for hosting, and Resend for authentication-related email delivery.
terms.p11/2: These services may experience outages or changes outside our control. Their own terms and policies may apply to the services they provide.

terms.p12/2: To the extent permitted by applicable law, we will not be liable for indirect, incidental, special, or consequential losses arising from the use of, or inability to use, the service.
terms.p12/3: Nothing in these terms excludes or limits rights, remedies, or liability that cannot legally be excluded or limited.
terms.p13: Your use of Scoutmaster is also subject to our Privacy Policy, which explains how account information and scouting records are collected, used, stored, and shared.
terms.p14: We may update these Terms of Service as Scoutmaster evolves or legal requirements change. Updated terms will be published with a revised effective date.
